description: EdDSA on an X25519 and an Ed25519 key returns the Ed25519 key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.1 (family): EdDSA is served by an Ed25519 key, and X25519 never matches EdDSA (RFC 8037 §3.1, §3.2); member 1 has no alg, use or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
